items.title: 1 Cash-Heavy Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: A surplus of cash can mean financial stability, but it can also indicate a reluctance (or inability) to invest in growth. Some of these companies also face challenges like stagnating revenue, declining market share, or limited scalability.

items.title: Workday (WDAY) Wins Big State Government Go Lives As AI Tools Spread
items.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS: WDAY) reports strong adoption among U.S. state and local governments replacing legacy HR and finance systems with its cloud platform. Large deployments in states including Georgia and Ohio highlight new public sector clients and recent go lives across core payroll, HR and finance functions. Workday is rolling out AI driven automation and agents to handle tasks such as payroll processing, workforce management and financial workflows for government users. The scale of these...

items.title: Cramer Says This Software Giant Is Fighting a Takeover With a $4 Billion Buyback
items.summary: Silver Lake wants Workday, but Workday just fired back with $4 billion and a packed calendar of public commitments. Jim Cramer says the company is fighting its own takeover, and the five-year chart reveals what investors are actually betting on.

items.title: AI Is Coming for One of Legacy Software’s Most Defensible Businesses as a New Challenger Takes on Oracle, SAP and Workday
items.summary: Swapping out an ERP system has been compared to open-heart surgery, which is exactly why Oracle, SAP, and Workday have held their ground through every technology wave. Now an AI-native startup backed by a former Sequoia partner is betting that a rebuilt architecture can finally make the pain worth it.
